task_b.verdict: not worth it now (prototype not built)
task_b.dedup_math: fused wu kernel: 360 HMMA m16n8k16 per chunk per warp; the two V-block CTAs of a head both compute w = A_wy.kb (64/warp) and A = q.k^T (40/warp), 104/360 duplicated -> 2-CTA cluster split saves 52/360 = 14.4% HMMA
task_b.upper_bound_gain: if the kernel were HMMA-throughput bound: 0.144 x 176 us = 25 us/call -> 6 ms at 16K (0.4%), 44 ms at 120K (0.2%); it is more likely latency bound (4 warps, 1 CTA/SM, 4 CTA barriers per chunk, sequential 32-chunk recurrence), and the pair would add a cluster barrier per chunk
task_b.feasibility: bit-exact is possible (each w/Ag element keeps its own mma chain; the peer reads the bf16 bytes via mapa + ld.shared::cluster). Must NOT use cp.async.bulk.shared::cluster (driver syscall, +1.37 GiB stack, see task C).
task_b.better_targets: FlashInfer prefill (66% of the 120K window) and the NVFP4 MoE GEMM (40% at 16K); after FLA the whole GDN core is 4.1% (16K) / 1.9% (120K)
